about: Independent base-R R30 from released six-site data and the public book two-state law. Exact expected-risk contrasts, grades and own denominators are pinned independently of paired Monte Carlo traces. All plotted losses and deltas, plus first/last followed states, are checked. Expected scientific outputs are copied only from R-generated JSON.
